ablation.boundary: Q6 FULL/B1/B3 plus separately collected Q7 B4; four Q7 first-request transport failures remain in the 24-trial denominator. Unknown usage is null in derived records; recorded sums and means over 24 reproduce Table 5.

direct.response_semantics: Response Action Proposal only; no host response executed

caveats.text: The eight scenarios are controlled Windows projections of public-source behaviors, not full campaign reproductions.
RQ1, the online and offline RQ2 comparisons, and RQ3 use separate trial populations.
Undefined precision or F1 remains null and is not converted to zero.
Offline Direct LLM action scores evaluate proposed operations and targets; no host actions are executed.
A2 was collected after FULL/A1/A3. All 24 selected A2 trials, including four first-request transport failures, are included.
A2 recorded tokens are summed over available usage and divided by all 24 selected trials for the paper mean; usage-unavailable requests are not measured zero-token calls.
